SELECT
    t.id,
    t.nome_abreviado AS nome,
    COALESCE(t.disponibilidade_informada_percentual, 0) AS disponibilidade,
    dc.descricao AS cargo,
    ds.descricao AS senioridade,
    COALESCE(
      json_agg(DISTINCT s.nome_skill) FILTER (WHERE s.nome_skill IS NOT NULL),
      '[]'::json
    ) AS skills
FROM "InHire".talentos t
LEFT JOIN "InHire".dominios dc ON dc.id = t.id_cargo AND dc.tipo_dominio = 'CARGO'
LEFT JOIN "InHire".dominios ds ON ds.id = t.id_senioridade AND ds.tipo_dominio = 'SENIORIDADE'
LEFT JOIN "InHire".talento_skills ts ON ts.id_talento = t.id
LEFT JOIN "InHire".skills s ON s.id = ts.id_skill AND s.status IS TRUE AND s.deletado IS FALSE
WHERE t.status IS TRUE
GROUP BY t.id, t.nome_abreviado, t.disponibilidade_informada_percentual, dc.descricao, ds.descricao
ORDER BY disponibilidade DESC, nome;

SELECT d.id, d.nome_demanda AS nome, contrato.nome_contrato AS projeto, andamento.descricao AS andamento, d.dt_inicio_demanda AS inicio, d.dt_termino_demanda_prevista AS termino, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS pessoas, COALESCE(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object('id', c.id, 'id_colaborador', c.id, 'nome', c.nome_abreviado, 'cargo', cargo.descricao, 'senioridade', senioridade.descricao, 'origem', 'Interno (SGD)', 'status', andamento.descricao, 'projeto', contrato.nome_contrato, 'id_demanda', d.id, 'nome_demanda', d.nome_demanda, 'inicio', d.dt_inicio_demanda, 'termino', d.dt_termino_demanda_prevista, 'alocacao_atual', (SELECT CONCAT(LEAST(100, COALESCE(SUM(px.porcentagem), 0)), '%') FROM "InHire".alocacoes alx JOIN "InHire".planejamentos px ON px.id_alocacao = alx.id WHERE alx.id_colaborador = c.id AND alx.status IS TRUE AND alx.deletado IS FALSE AND px.status IS TRUE AND px.deletado IS FALSE), 'percentual_na_demanda', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(px.porcentagem), 0) FROM "InHire".alocacoes alx JOIN "InHire".planejamentos px ON px.id_alocacao = alx.id WHERE alx.id_colaborador = c.id AND alx.id_demanda = d.id AND alx.status IS TRUE AND alx.deletado IS FALSE AND px.status IS TRUE AND px.deletado IS FALSE), 'skills_detalhadas', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('nome', sk.nome_skill, 'nivel', cs.nivel_conhecimento) ORDER BY sk.nome_skill), '[]'::jsonb) FROM "InHire".colaborador_skills cs JOIN "InHire".skills sk ON sk.id = cs.id_skill WHERE cs.id_colaborador = c.id AND cs.status IS TRUE AND cs.deletado IS FALSE AND sk.status IS TRUE AND sk.deletado IS FALSE))) FILTER (WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb) AS colaboradores
FROM "InHire".demandas d
LEFT JOIN "InHire".contratos contrato ON contrato.id = d.id_contrato AND contrato.status IS TRUE AND contrato.deletado IS FALSE
LEFT JOIN "InHire".dominios andamento ON andamento.id = d.id_andamento_demanda AND andamento.status IS TRUE AND andamento.deletado IS FALSE
LEFT JOIN "InHire".alocacoes a ON a.id_demanda = d.id AND a.status IS TRUE AND a.deletado IS FALSE
LEFT JOIN "InHire".colaboradores c ON c.id = a.id_colaborador AND c.status IS TRUE AND c.deletado IS FALSE
LEFT JOIN "InHire".dominios cargo ON cargo.id = c.id_cargo AND cargo.status IS TRUE AND cargo.deletado IS FALSE
LEFT JOIN "InHire".dominios senioridade ON senioridade.id = c.id_senioridade AND senioridade.status IS TRUE AND senioridade.deletado IS FALSE
WHERE d.status IS TRUE AND d.deletado IS FALSE
GROUP BY d.id, d.nome_demanda, contrato.nome_contrato, andamento.descricao, d.dt_inicio_demanda, d.dt_termino_demanda_prevista
ORDER BY d.id;
